      "snippet": "\ud83d\udc4d Exactly \u2014 Termux sometimes pauses after termux-setup-storage because:\n\nAndroid throws a permission dialog the first time\n\nIf that dialog already happened earlier, Termux just waits for a newline\n\nPressing Enter tells it \u201cyeah, permission is already granted, continue\u201d\n\nSo what you saw is normal
